item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00238","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C14","C25","C04"],"selected_candidate_label":"C14","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C14 is the direct initiating directive for the investigation discussed in the child and supplies several concrete elements of its drafting: the National Security Council's use of the Interdepartmental Committee on Internal Security with Civil Service Commission participation; examination of employee-security administration; consideration of uniform standards and procedures and central review; and a direction that affected agencies cooperate fully. The child expressly recounts that request, reports the resulting findings, and develops the next administrative action from them. C25 and C04 share related review machinery and subject matter, but neither matches this direct procedural and textual lineage as closely.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"On July 14, 1951, I requested the National Security Council to make an investigation of the administration of Federal employee security programs... Pursuant to that request, a study was made by the Interdepartmental Committee on Internal Security.","parent_excerpt":"I should like the National Security Council, utilizing its Interdepartmental Committee on Internal Security, and with the participation of the Civil Service Commission, to make an investigation of the way this program is being administered","explanation":"The child explicitly identifies and describes the investigation ordered by C14."},{"child_excerpt":"This report recommends that certain uniform standards and procedures be established... It also recommends that provision be made for Civil Service Commission review of agency decisions in security risk cases.","parent_excerpt":"I should like consideration given to whether provision should be made for uniform standards and procedures and for central review of the decisions made in the various departments and agencies.","explanation":"The child repeats the two specific issues that C14 instructed the investigation to examine, adapting central review into Civil Service Commission review."},{"child_excerpt":"I am directing all Executive departments and agencies to cooperate fully with the Commission and to furnish the Commission with such personnel and other assistance as it may require.","parent_excerpt":"I am asking each of the departments and agencies concerned to cooperate fully in this study.","explanation":"Both use the same government-wide cooperation mechanism, with the child expanding the requested assistance."}]}
